title: Hanuma falls in dilemma
introduction: Hanuma falls in a dilemma whether to console Seetha or to remain silent. Finally Hanuma decides to console Seetha, by eulogising Rama's attributes in a sweet voice, so that Seetha can give credence to his words.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 30th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic

verses.devanagari:
हनुमान् अपि विक्रान्तः सर्वम् शुश्राव तत्त्वतः |
सीतायाः त्रिजटायाः च राक्षसीनाम् च तर्जनम्
verses.iast:
hanumān api vikrāntaḥ sarvam śuśrāva tattvataḥ |
sītāyāḥ trijaṭāyāḥ ca rākṣasīnām ca tarjanam
verses.translation: The valiant Hanuma also heard truly all those words of Seetha, Trijata and the threatening words of the female demons.

verses.devanagari:
अवेक्षमाणः ताम् देवीम् देवताम् इव नन्दने |
ततो बहु विधाम् चिन्ताम् चिन्तयामास वानरः
verses.iast:
avekṣamāṇaḥ tām devīm devatām iva nandane |
tato bahu vidhām cintām cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, seeing that Seetha as a divine lady in the garden of Nandana, Hanuma echoed his thought in various ways.

verses.devanagari:
याम् कपीनाम् सहस्राणि सुबहूनि अयुतानि च |
दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते सा इयम् आसादिता मया
verses.iast:
yām kapīnām sahasrāṇi subahūni ayutāni ca |
dikṣu sarvāsu mārgante sā iyam āsāditā mayā
verses.translation: "Which Seetha is being searched in all directions by many thousands and myriads of monkeys, the same Seetha has been found by me."

verses.devanagari:
चारेण तु सुयुक्तेन शत्रोः शक्तिम् अवेक्षिता |
गूढेन चरता तावत् अवेक्षितम् इदम् मया
verses.iast:
cāreṇa tu suyuktena śatroḥ śaktim avekṣitā |
gūḍhena caratā tāvat avekṣitam idam mayā
verses.translation: "By me, employed thoughtfully (by my Master) as a secret agent and gone about secretly with a view to ascertain the enemy's strength, this has been perceived.

glosses.meaning: in my view to ascertain the enemy's strength

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसानाम् विशेषः च पुरी च इयम् अवेक्षिता |
राक्षस अधिपतेः अस्य प्रभावो रावणस्य च
verses.iast:
rākṣasānām viśeṣaḥ ca purī ca iyam avekṣitā |
rākṣasa adhipateḥ asya prabhāvo rāvaṇasya ca
verses.translation: "The characteristics of demons, this town and the power of the king of demons, Ravana, have been perceived by me."

verses.devanagari:
युक्तम् तस्य अप्रमेयस्य सर्व सत्त्व दयावतः |
समाश्वासयितुम् भार्याम् पतिदर्शन कान्क्षिणीम्
verses.iast:
yuktam tasya aprameyasya sarva sattva dayāvataḥ |
samāśvāsayitum bhāryām patidarśana kānkṣiṇīm
verses.translation: "It is proper for me to console the wife of Rama, desirous of seeing her husband who is compassionate towards all beings and who is of immeasurable might."

glosses.meaning: to console her who is desirous of seeing her husband
who is compassionate towards all beings
and who is of immeasurable might.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् आश्वासयामि एनाम् पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननाम् |
अदृष्ट दुह्खाम् दुह्खस्य न हि अन्तम् अधिगच्छतीम्
verses.iast:
aham āśvāsayāmi enām pūrṇa candra nibha ānanām |
adṛṣṭa duhkhām duhkhasya na hi antam adhigacchatīm
verses.translation: "I shall console this woman, whose face resembles a full moon, who is having an unforeseen affliction, who is tormented by grief and who is not attaining the end to her affliction."

glosses.meaning: whose face resembles a full moon
who is having an unforeseen affliction

verses.devanagari:
यदि हि अहम् इमाम् देवीम् शोक उपहत चेतनाम् |
अनाश्वास्य गमिष्यामि दोषवत् गमनम् भवेत्
verses.iast:
yadi hi aham imām devīm śoka upahata cetanām |
anāśvāsya gamiṣyāmi doṣavat gamanam bhavet
verses.translation: "If I return without consoling this Seetha, the wife of Rama, even though her mind is tormented by grief, my departure becomes blemished."

glosses.meaning: even though her mind is tormented by grief

verses.devanagari:
गते हि मयि तत्र इयम् राज पुत्री यशस्विनी |
परित्राणम् अविन्दन्ती जानकी जीवितम् त्यजेत्
verses.iast:
gate hi mayi tatra iyam rāja putrī yaśasvinī |
paritrāṇam avindantī jānakī jīvitam tyajet
verses.translation: "Not finding a rescue when I return to Kishkindha, the illustrious princess Seetha may give up her life."

verses.devanagari:
मया च स महाबाहुः पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननः |
समाश्वासयितुम् न्याय्यः सीता दर्शन लालसः
verses.iast:
mayā ca sa mahābāhuḥ pūrṇa candra nibha ānanaḥ |
samāśvāsayitum nyāyyaḥ sītā darśana lālasaḥ
verses.translation: "That long-armed Rama having the countenance of a full moon, eagerly longing to see Seetha, is fit to be consoled by me."

glosses.meaning: with the countenance of a full moon

verses.devanagari:
निशा चरीणाम् प्रत्यक्षम् अक्षमम् च अभिभाषणम् |
कथम् नु खलु कर्तव्यम् इदम् कृच्छ्र गतो हि अहम्
verses.iast:
niśā carīṇām pratyakṣam akṣamam ca abhibhāṣaṇam |
katham nu khalu kartavyam idam kṛcchra gato hi aham
verses.translation: "It is not proper to speak with her within the sight of these female-demons. How indeed is this to be done? I am indeed perplexed."

glosses.meaning: within the sight of nishaachariiNaam = the female-demon

verses.devanagari:
अनेन रात्रि शेषेण यदि न आश्वास्यते मया |
सर्वथा न अस्ति संदेहः परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्
verses.iast:
anena rātri śeṣeṇa yadi na āśvāsyate mayā |
sarvathā na asti saṃdehaḥ parityakṣyati jīvitam
verses.translation: "If she is not consoled by me during the rest of this night, she will forsake her life by all means. There is no doubt about it."

glosses.meaning: during the rest of this night

verses.devanagari:
रामः च यदि पृच्छेन् माम् किम् माम् सीता अब्रवीत् वचः |
किम् अहम् तम् प्रतिब्रूयाम् असम्भाष्य सुमध्यमाम्
verses.iast:
rāmaḥ ca yadi pṛcchen mām kim mām sītā abravīt vacaḥ |
kim aham tam pratibrūyām asambhāṣya sumadhyamām
verses.translation: "If Rama enquires of me as to what words did Seetha speak about him, what can I say to Rama without speaking now to this Seetha, the slender-waisted lady?"

verses.devanagari:
सीता संदेश रहितम् माम् इतः त्वरया गतम् |
निर्दहेत् अपि काकुत्स्थः क्रुद्धः तीव्रेण चक्षुषा
verses.iast:
sītā saṃdeśa rahitam mām itaḥ tvarayā gatam |
nirdahet api kākutsthaḥ kruddhaḥ tīvreṇa cakṣuṣā
verses.translation: "To me returning in haste from here without carrying Seetha's message Rama may get irritated and burn me up with his pungent eyes."

verses.devanagari:
यदि चेत् योजयिष्यामि भर्तारम् राम कारणात् |
व्यर्थम् आगमनम् तस्य ससैन्यस्य भविष्यति
verses.iast:
yadi cet yojayiṣyāmi bhartāram rāma kāraṇāt |
vyartham āgamanam tasya sasainyasya bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "Even if I instigate my master Sugreeva to do his best in the cause of Rama, his arrival here with an army will be futile."

glosses.meaning: even if I instigate my master Sugreeva to do his best

verses.devanagari:
अन्तरम् तु अहम् आसाद्य राक्षसीनाम् इह स्थितः |
शनैः आश्वासयिष्यामि सम्ताप बहुलाम् इमाम्
verses.iast:
antaram tu aham āsādya rākṣasīnām iha sthitaḥ |
śanaiḥ āśvāsayiṣyāmi samtāpa bahulām imām
verses.translation: "Staying here itself and getting hold of an opportunity even in the midst of the female-demons (when they are in attentive), I shall slowly console Seetha who is very much in distress."

glosses.meaning: even in the midst of the female-demons
who is very much in distress.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् हि अतितनुः चैव वनरः च विशेषतः |
वाचम् च उदाहरिष्यामि मानुषीम् इह संस्कृताम्
verses.iast:
aham hi atitanuḥ caiva vanaraḥ ca viśeṣataḥ |
vācam ca udāhariṣyāmi mānuṣīm iha saṃskṛtām
verses.translation: "However, I am very small in stature, particularly as a monkey and can speak now Sanskrit, the human language too."

verses.devanagari:
यदि वाचम् प्रदास्यामि द्विजातिः इव संस्कृताम् |
रावणम् मन्यमाना माम् सीता भीता भविष्यति
वानरस्य विशेषेण कथं स्यादभिभाषणम्म् |
verses.iast:
yadi vācam pradāsyāmi dvijātiḥ iva saṃskṛtām |
rāvaṇam manyamānā mām sītā bhītā bhaviṣyati
vānarasya viśeṣeṇa kathaṃ syādabhibhāṣaṇamm |
verses.translation: "If I use Sanskrit language like a brahmin, Seetha will get frightened, thinking me as Ravana. Especially, how can a monkey speak it?"

verses.devanagari:
अवश्यम् एव वक्तव्यम् मानुषम् वाक्यम् अर्थवत्
मया सान्त्वयितुम् शक्या न अन्यथा इयम् अनिन्दिता |
verses.iast:
avaśyam eva vaktavyam mānuṣam vākyam arthavat
mayā sāntvayitum śakyā na anyathā iyam aninditā |
verses.translation: "Certainly, meaningful words of a human being are to be spoken by me. Otherwise, the virtuous Seetha cannot be consoled."

verses.devanagari:
सा इयम् आलोक्य मे रूपम् जानकी भाषितम् तथा
रक्षोभिः त्रासिता पूर्वम् भूयः त्रासम् गमिष्यति |
verses.iast:
sā iyam ālokya me rūpam jānakī bhāṣitam tathā
rakṣobhiḥ trāsitā pūrvam bhūyaḥ trāsam gamiṣyati |
verses.translation: "Looking at my figure and the language, Seetha who was already frightened previously by the demons, will get frightened again."

verses.devanagari:
ततो जात परित्रासा शब्दम् कुर्यान् मनस्विनी
जानमाना विशाल अक्षी रावणम् काम रूपिणम् |
verses.iast:
tato jāta paritrāsā śabdam kuryān manasvinī
jānamānā viśāla akṣī rāvaṇam kāma rūpiṇam |
verses.translation: "Thereafter, this large-eyed Seetha who is full of mind, thinking me as Ravana who can assume any form at will, may shout loudly, engendered by fear."

glosses.meaning: who can assume any form at will

verses.devanagari:
सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहसा राक्षसी गणः
नाना प्रहरणो घोरः समेयात् अन्तक उपमः |
verses.iast:
sītayā ca kṛte śabde sahasā rākṣasī gaṇaḥ
nānā praharaṇo ghoraḥ sameyāt antaka upamaḥ |
verses.translation: "As soon as Seetha shouts loudly, a troop of female-demons, wielding various kinds of weapons and appearing dreadful as Yama the Lord of Death, may assemble here."

glosses.meaning: as Yama the Lord of Death

verses.devanagari:
ततो माम् सम्परिक्षिप्य सर्वतो विकृत आननाः
वधे च ग्रहणे चैव कुर्युः यत्नम् यथा बलम् |
verses.iast:
tato mām samparikṣipya sarvato vikṛta ānanāḥ
vadhe ca grahaṇe caiva kuryuḥ yatnam yathā balam |
verses.translation: "Then those ugly faced female-demons may encircle me from all sides and try to catch and kill me with all their might."

glosses.meaning: those female demons with their ugly faces

verses.devanagari:
गृह्य शाखाः प्रशाखाश्च स्कन्धांश्चोत्तमशाखिनाम्
दृष्ट्वा विपरिधावन्तं भवेयुर्भयशङ्किताः |
verses.iast:
gṛhya śākhāḥ praśākhāśca skandhāṃścottamaśākhinām
dṛṣṭvā viparidhāvantaṃ bhaveyurbhayaśaṇ^kitāḥ |
verses.translation: "Then, seeing me running hither and thither, seizing big branches, twigs and trunks of excellent trees, they may get alarmed with fear."

verses.devanagari:
मम रूपम् च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वनम् विचरतो महत्
राक्षस्यो भय वित्रस्ता भवेयुः विकृत आननाः |
verses.iast:
mama rūpam ca samprekṣya vanam vicarato mahat
rākṣasyo bhaya vitrastā bhaveyuḥ vikṛta ānanāḥ |
verses.translation: "The ugly faced female-demons will be frightened with fear, after seeing my huge figure wandering in the grove."

verses.devanagari:
ततः कुर्युः समाह्वानम् राक्षस्यो रक्षसाम् अपि
राक्षस इन्द्र नियुक्तानाम् राक्षस इन्द्र निवेशने |
verses.iast:
tataḥ kuryuḥ samāhvānam rākṣasyo rakṣasām api
rākṣasa indra niyuktānām rākṣasa indra niveśane |
verses.translation: "Then those female-demons may call the other demons too retained by Ravana in his house."

verses.devanagari:
ते शूल शर निस्त्रिंश विविध आयुध पाणयः
आपतेयुः विमर्दे अस्मिन् वेगेन उद्विग्न कारिणः |
verses.iast:
te śūla śara nistriṃśa vividha āyudha pāṇayaḥ
āpateyuḥ vimarde asmin vegena udvigna kāriṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "Those female-demons with an element of turbulence and rapidity may rush into a battle with various kinds of weapons like spears lances and swords."

glosses.meaning: with various kinds of weapons like spears

verses.devanagari:
सम्क्रुद्धः तैः तु परितो विधमन् रक्षसाम् बलम्
शक्नुयम् न तु सम्प्राप्तुम् परम् पारम् महाउदधेः |
verses.iast:
samkruddhaḥ taiḥ tu parito vidhaman rakṣasām balam
śaknuyam na tu samprāptum param pāram mahāudadheḥ |
verses.translation: "Surrounded on all sides by them, I may not be able to reach the other shore of the great ocean, while destroying the army of demons."

verses.devanagari:
माम् वा गृह्णीयुः आप्लुत्य बहवः शीघ्र कारिणः
स्यात् इयम् च अगृहीत अर्था मम च ग्रहणम् भवेत् |
verses.iast:
mām vā gṛhṇīyuḥ āplutya bahavaḥ śīghra kāriṇaḥ
syāt iyam ca agṛhīta arthā mama ca grahaṇam bhavet |
verses.translation: "Or having jumped up (over me) many demons operating speedily may capture me. Then, Seetha may not be able to know the occurrence of my arrival. Even I may get captured too."

glosses.meaning: not comprehending the sense mama = my

verses.devanagari:
हिंसा अभिरुचयो हिंस्युः इमाम् वा जनक आत्मजाम्
विपन्नम् स्यात् ततः कार्यम् राम सुग्रीवयोः इदम् |
verses.iast:
hiṃsā abhirucayo hiṃsyuḥ imām vā janaka ātmajām
vipannam syāt tataḥ kāryam rāma sugrīvayoḥ idam |
verses.translation: "Or the violent minded demons may kill this Seetha. Consequently this work of Rama and Sugreeva will be ruined."

verses.devanagari:
उद्देशे नष्ट मार्गे अस्मिन् राक्षसैः परिवारिते
सागरेण परिक्षिप्ते गुप्ते वसति जानकी |
verses.iast:
uddeśe naṣṭa mārge asmin rākṣasaiḥ parivārite
sāgareṇa parikṣipte gupte vasati jānakī |
verses.translation: "Seetha is residing in this secret place, with a concealed access, surrounded by demons and encircled by an ocean."

verses.devanagari:
विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिः मयि सम्युगे
न अन्यम् पश्यामि रामस्य सहायम् कार्य साधने |
verses.iast:
viśaste vā gṛhīte vā rakṣobhiḥ mayi samyuge
na anyam paśyāmi rāmasya sahāyam kārya sādhane |
verses.translation: "If I am killed in the battle or got captured by the demons, I do not see any other companion for Rama who can fulfill this work (of searching for Seetha)."

glosses.meaning: in fulfilling this work (of searching for Seetha).

verses.devanagari:
विमृशन् च न पश्यामि यो हते मयि वानरः
शत योजन विस्तीर्णम् लन्घयेत महाउदधिम् |
verses.iast:
vimṛśan ca na paśyāmi yo hate mayi vānaraḥ
śata yojana vistīrṇam langhayeta mahāudadhim |
verses.translation: "Even after due reflection, I do not see any monkey who can transgress the ocean with a breadth of one hundred Yojanas, in case I am killed."

glosses.meaning: with a breadth od one hundred yoganas

verses.devanagari:
कामम् हन्तुम् समर्थो अस्मि सहस्राणि अपि रक्षसाम्
न तु शक्ष्यामि सम्प्राप्तुम् परम् पारम् महाउदधेः |
verses.iast:
kāmam hantum samartho asmi sahasrāṇi api rakṣasām
na tu śakṣyāmi samprāptum param pāram mahāudadheḥ |
verses.translation: "I am competent to kill even thousands of demons. I am quite sure. But, after doing such a large battle, I may not be capable of reaching the other shore of the ocean."

glosses.meaning: with a breadth of one hundred yoganas

verses.devanagari:
असत्यानि च युद्धानि संशयो मे न रोचते
कः च निह्संशयम् कार्यम् कुर्यात् प्राज्ञः ससंशयम् |
verses.iast:
asatyāni ca yuddhāni saṃśayo me na rocate
kaḥ ca nihsaṃśayam kāryam kuryāt prājñaḥ sasaṃśayam |
verses.translation: 'Conflicts are unreal too and to me, there is no desire for uncertainty. which intellectual will do an assured act with an apprehension?"

verses.devanagari:
एष दोषो महान् हि स्यान् मम सीता अभिभाषणे
प्राण त्यागः च वैदेह्या भवेत् अनभिभाषणे |
verses.iast:
eṣa doṣo mahān hi syān mama sītā abhibhāṣaṇe
prāṇa tyāgaḥ ca vaidehyā bhavet anabhibhāṣaṇe |
verses.translation: "If I do not talk, there will be Seetha's death. If I talk to Seetha, this great lapse will occur."

verses.devanagari:
भूताः च अर्था विनश्यन्ति देश काल विरोधिताः
विक्लवम् दूतम् आसाद्य तमः सूर्य उदये यथा |
verses.iast:
bhūtāḥ ca arthā vinaśyanti deśa kāla virodhitāḥ
viklavam dūtam āsādya tamaḥ sūrya udaye yathā |
verses.translation: "Actions which are going to be accomplished shortly, get spoiled at the hands of a accomplished shortly, get spoiled at the hands of a confused messenger, when the actions are set in opposition to time and space, even as darkness disappears at sun rise."

glosses.meaning: which are going to be accomplished
when they are set in opposition to time and space

verses.devanagari:
अर्थ अनर्थ अन्तरे बुद्धिः निश्चिता अपि न शोभते
घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डित मानिनः |
verses.iast:
artha anartha antare buddhiḥ niścitā api na śobhate
ghātayanti hi kāryāṇi dūtāḥ paṇḍita māninaḥ |
verses.translation: "Even if a decision is taken, regarding what is worthy and what is worthless, it does not yield good results. Messengers boasting themselves to be learned, thus indeed ruin those actions."

glosses.meaning: even if a decision is taken

verses.devanagari:
न विनश्येत् कथम् कार्यम् वैक्लव्यम् न कथम् भवेत्
लन्घनम् च समुद्रस्य कथम् नु न वृथा भवेत् |
verses.iast:
na vinaśyet katham kāryam vaiklavyam na katham bhavet
langhanam ca samudrasya katham nu na vṛthā bhavet |
verses.translation: "How does not my work get spoiled? How should I avoid my feebleness? Also how does not my leaping across the sea become vain?"

verses.devanagari:
कथम् नु खलु वाक्यम् मे शृणुयान् न उद्विजेत च
इति संचिन्त्य हनुमान् चकार मतिमान् मतिम् |
verses.iast:
katham nu khalu vākyam me śṛṇuyān na udvijeta ca
iti saṃcintya hanumān cakāra matimān matim |
verses.translation: "How can Seetha hear my words without fear?" Thinking in this way, the wise Hanuma made up his mind (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
रामम् अक्लिष्ट कर्माणम् स्व बन्धुम् अनुकीर्तयन्
न एनाम् उद्वेजयिष्यामि तत् बन्धु गत मानसाम् |
verses.iast:
rāmam akliṣṭa karmāṇam sva bandhum anukīrtayan
na enām udvejayiṣyāmi tat bandhu gata mānasām |
verses.translation: "If I eulogize Rama, who is unwearied in action and a good relation, I shall not frighten her, whose mind is directed towards that relation."

glosses.meaning: whose mind is directed towards that relation.

verses.devanagari:
इक्ष्वाकूणाम् वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदित आत्मनः
शुभानि धर्म युक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन् |
श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुराम् प्रब्रुवन् गिरम्
श्रद्धास्यति यथा हि इयम् तथा सर्वम् समादधे |
verses.iast:
ikṣvākūṇām variṣṭhasya rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ
śubhāni dharma yuktāni vacanāni samarpayan |
śrāvayiṣyāmi sarvāṇi madhurām prabruvan giram
śraddhāsyati yathā hi iyam tathā sarvam samādadhe |
verses.translation: "Offering auspicious and righteous words about Rama the most excellent prince Ikshvaku dynasty who possesses a learned soul and myself speaking in a sweet voice, I shall make everything intelligible so that Seetha rightly believes everything."

verses.devanagari:
इति स बहु विधम् महाअनुभावो |
जगति पतेः प्रमदाम् अवेक्षमाणः |
मधुरम् अवितथम् जगाद वाक्यम् |
द्रुम विटप अन्तरम् आस्थितो
verses.iast:
iti sa bahu vidham mahāanubhāvo |
jagati pateḥ pramadām avekṣamāṇaḥ |
madhuram avitatham jagāda vākyam |
druma viṭapa antaram āsthito
verses.translation: The noble-minded Hanuman, abiding in the midst of the twigs of the trees and seeing Seetha, spoke the following words of many kinds which were not futile.

glosses.meaning: in the midst of the twigs of the trees
